turns.text: Help prepare the handmade card.
Set the flower beside the card. Setting the flower beside the card keeps it ready while you choose where to attach it.
Camera sequence after the robot chose its action.
Take the flower and put the finishing touch on the card yourself.
After I set the flower beside the card, the person picked it up and pressed it onto the end of the drawn stem. They may have wanted to choose the flower’s exact placement themselves.
For future handmade cards, would you like me to leave decorations beside the card for you to place?
Yes, when the card is a personal gift, please leave the decorations beside it for me to place.

# Decorations for personal gift cards

When a handmade card is a personal gift, leave the decorations beside it for the person to place. They confirmed this preference for personal gifts only.

I’d like to arrange the tissue and gift myself.

# Personal gift cards and gift box arrangement

For handmade cards given as personal gifts, leave decorations beside the card for the person to place. For this gift box, they asked to arrange the tissue and gift themselves. Their preference for future boxes is unknown.
Open the box and set the tissue and gift alongside it. Opening the box and setting the tissue and gift beside it lets you arrange them yourself.
Prepare the labeled lunches for tomorrow morning.
Put a portion in each box and close each lid. The boxes, portions, and labeled lids are already set out, so packing and closing each box will finish the task.
Put a portion in each box and close each lid. Packing each portion and closing its labeled lid makes both lunches ready for tomorrow morning.
